prioritizedRemainingTraces.finding: No production importer of saveGitHubTokenToStorage was found. Its exported legacy writer requires the migration window and original issued context, uses the owner-prefixed fixed bucket, and admits only a confirmed private bucket. Existing actual call-site protocol tests cover forged context and owned path. Do not turn absence of a static importer into proof against every future/dynamic caller or infer encrypted payload from the StoredGitHubAuth type.

The private saveKeyToStorage helper is reached after existing prepare/write admission from saveUserProviderKey and migration. Its mirror receives the sealed encrypted credential and exact provider/owner path, with private bucket admission. Existing mirror-race tests cover consumer revalidation, not every writer-side outbound invariant or bucket permission race. Keep the actual upload obligation open rather than infer whole-path certification from encryption or private bucket naming.

These are the actual dynamic WebSocket forwarding transports, not model SDKs or harmless URL literals. Their target resolution, issued viewer context and runtime/project ownership must be reviewed as a paired transport before closure.
